questions.prompt: Put the laser printing process in order.
questions.explanation: Knowing the order helps you link a print fault to the part that causes it.

questions.prompt: Jobs are stuck in the queue and will not cancel. What should you do?
questions.explanation: Restarting the Spooler usually clears stuck jobs. Only delete the job files inside the folder if needed.

questions.prompt: Printed pages smudge when touched. Which part is most likely at fault?
questions.explanation: The fuser melts toner onto the paper; if it fails, toner does not bond.

questions.prompt: How should you clear a paper jam? Select all that apply.
choices: Turn the printer off and let it cool
Pull the paper slowly in its normal direction
Use both hands so it does not tear
Pull hard while the printer is running
questions.explanation: The fuser is hot and moving parts are dangerous while it runs.

questions.prompt: Where should you get a printer driver?
choices: A USB drive from a friend
questions.explanation: Official drivers match the model and are free of malware.
